description: The Geoportal Catastro Nacional is the web geoportal of the Dirección General del Catastro Nacional (DGCN) of the Dominican Republic; note that round 1 found it while walking Paraguay, but the portal belongs to the Dominican cadastre (catastro.gob.do). The portal read on 2026-09-28 offers cadastral viewers of the country's real estate with cadastral designations, land use, land value, building categories and cadastral statistics, a parcel locator that flags parcels inside protected areas, a layer of road axes (streets and highways of the country), and 3D maps of pilot areas such as Pepillo Salcedo and the Gascue sector of the Distrito Nacional; it describes the Pepillo Salcedo multipurpose cadastre, surveyed with drones at up to 2 cm accuracy, as the pilot for the rest of the country. Access is free through an ArcGIS Hub site with datasets, documents, apps and maps, and the DGCN states a policy of open standards, APIs and interoperability; no licence is named on the home page. Caveats: parcel-level coverage exists only where the multipurpose cadastre has been surveyed, and download options differ per layer. It supports exposure analysis of buildings and parcels to hazards and planning of services from land use. No related national record exists yet in the catalogue for the Dominican Republic cadastre.
